phrase.en: Unfortunately, our flight has been cancelled.
phrase.es: Por desgracia, han cancelado nuestro vuelo.

text.ru: Когда неважно, кто сделал, — пассив: has been + 3-я форма. Русское «рейс отменили» = The flight has been cancelled. Unfortunately обычно в начале, через запятую.
text.en: When who did it doesn’t matter, use the passive: has been + past participle. The flight has been cancelled. Unfortunately usually starts the sentence, followed by a comma.
text.es: Cuando no importa quién lo hizo: pasiva has been + participio — The flight has been cancelled. Unfortunately suele ir al principio.

exercises.en: Unfortunately, the flight has been cancelled.
